title: Clorox Pool & Spa Swimming Pool Alkalinity Increaser, Keeps pH Balanced, 16LB (Pack of 1)

reviews.title: a must have for pool owners
reviews.body: For anyone serious about pool maintenance, the Clorox Pool&Spa 12016CLX Total Alkalinity Increaser is a game-changer. Here are the reasons it rightfully claims a full 5-star rating:Effective Performance: This product does precisely what it claims. After using it, I noticed a rapid stabilization in the pH levels of my pool, reducing those annoying fluctuations that can wreak havoc on the water quality.Large Quantity: The 16-pound package ensures long-term use, eliminating the need for frequent repurchases. It's an excellent value for the money.Easy to Use: The instructions are clear and straightforward. Even if you're a newbie to pool maintenance, you'll find this product simple to apply.Safe on Pool Liners & Equipment: One of my initial concerns was if the chemical might damage my pool liners or equipment. I was relieved to find that it's gentle and non-corrosive, ensuring that the pool components remain unaffected.High-Quality Packaging: The packaging is robust, ensuring no spills or damage during transit. Plus, the white aesthetic is clean and professional, making storage neat and easy.All in all, the Clorox Pool&Spa 12016CLX Total Alkalinity Increaser has made a noticeable difference in the quality and stability of my pool water. For those looking for a reliable solution to maintaining their pool's pH levels, I can't recommend this product enough. It's a solid investment for every pool owner. Cheers to clear and balanced water!

features: For Raising Total Alkalinity: The Alkalinity Increaser helps maintain balanced pH levels in your pool water. Proper alkalinity levels reduce the need for frequent maintenance, and our product's granulated formula is easy to apply and dissolves quickly.

Improves Swimmer Comfort: This product plays a crucial role in enhancing swimmer comfort by preventing eye and skin irritation caused by unbalanced pH. It helps prevent dry, itchy skin and red, burning eyes, ensuring a more pleasant swimming experience.

Protects Pool Equipment from Corrosion: By keeping your pool's pH level balanced, this product helps prevent equipment corrosion, allowing you to spend less time maintaining and more time enjoying your swimming pool.
Perfect for All Pools: Clorox Pool&Spa Swimming Pool Chlorine Stabilizer is perfect for new pools, freshly refilled pools, saltwater pools, and pools that use liquid chlorine.
Clorox Pool App: Test like an expert anytime, anywhere with the Clorox Pool App. Solve common swimming pool problems and get personalized product and dosage recommendations.
